decoded.meaning: ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0031 (tr::schema::not_found) } — the reply the golden core actually builds when a peer names the STREAM ring depth, which has NO wire surface at all (§5.7)
decoded.note: the wire-observable half of RFC-0022 §3.C: the depth is set host-side by graph_t::set_history_depth and is neither read nor written remotely, so both a read and a write of the old knob name resolve to nothing. Byte-identical to settings/removed-knob — the ERROR identity carries no name detail, so `history_keep_last` is answered exactly as any other withdrawn knob is.
